quotes.name: Biolume Egg // Biolume Serpent
quotes.flavor: ...knowing their hatchlings are more fearsome than anything else that might come along.

quotes.name: Swaggering Corsair
quotes.flavor: "I'm about to make you famous. From the golden city to High and Dry, they'll talk about how fast you died!"

quotes.name: Run Away Together
quotes.flavor: Nobody bothered to look for Libo and Pulla, because everyone knew they didn't want to be found.

quotes.name: Bloodgift Demon
quotes.flavor: He relishes the devotion of his Skirsdag puppets and their belief that it will earn them immortality.

quotes.name: Souldrinker
quotes.flavor: Don't drink and thrive.

quotes.name: Eternal Taskmaster
quotes.flavor:
"They are called Eternals. They will never stop."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Filigree Familiar
quotes.flavor:
"It's the must-have gift for everyone on your list. Get one for yourself, too!"
—Chammi, curio vendor

quotes.name: Marauding Sphinx
quotes.flavor: She poses a riddle to each mark, allowing them a chance to keep their goods. Thus far, none have succeeded.

quotes.name: Vampire Scrivener
quotes.flavor: No one remains on her list for long.

quotes.name: Pestilent Cauldron // Restorative Burst
quotes.flavor: "Death? Everyone does death. Let me show you something actually impressive."

quotes.name: Prairie Stream
quotes.flavor:
"Strictly speaking, it's the fifteenth New York since the original, so that makes it New New New New New New New New New New New New New New New New York."
—The Tenth Doctor

quotes.name: Minas Tirith
quotes.flavor:
"I would see the White Tree in flower again in the courts of the kings, and Minas Tirith in peace."
—Faramir

quotes.name: Triton Shorestalker
quotes.flavor: "Who will miss you, drywalker? A wife? A child? Perhaps they will blame the sea for your fate, and teach future generations to stay far away from it."

quotes.name: Benalish Hero
quotes.flavor: Benalia has a complex caste system that changes with the lunar year. No matter what the season, the only caste that cannot be attained by either heredity or money is that of the hero.

quotes.name: Mind Stone
quotes.flavor:
"Handles, I said, 'Put me on a ship.' I didn't say, 'Put me on a Dalek ship.'"
—The Eleventh Doctor

quotes.name: Phyrexian Broodlings
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Phyrexia vs. the Coalition
quotes.flavor: With limited resources and near unlimited time, Kerrick used parts from one beast to build another.

quotes.name: Foam Weapons Kiosk
quotes.flavor: Not suitable for children . . . who aren't ready to have a lot of fun!

quotes.name: Incisor Glider
quotes.flavor:
"You think it's creepy now? You should see how it eats."
—Melira

quotes.name: Talisman of Resilience
quotes.flavor:
"The continual rise of the downtrodden is as inevitable as vines usurping a forest."
—Vraska

quotes.name: Mother of Runes
quotes.flavor: Her boundless love has moved many. Her confidence has moved mountains.

quotes.name: Tatterkite
quotes.flavor:
"I rigged it together from wicker and scrap, yet somehow I find it unalterably perfect."
—Braenna, cobblesmith

quotes.name: Voidslime
quotes.flavor: "Cyclonic Ri—fplfmplfmlfblthpfmnsnffl!"

quotes.name: Carrion Ants
quotes.flavor: "War is no picnic," my father liked to say. But the Ants seemed to disagree.

quotes.name: Roughshod Mentor
quotes.flavor: He didn't hear the cries of the treefolk whose branches he snapped or of the elves caught underfoot. He had eyes only for the path ahead.

quotes.name: Icy Manipulator
quotes.flavor:
"The scavengers who first found it called it the 'Bone Crank.' Not a bad name, I'd say."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

quotes.name: Giant Spider
quotes.flavor:
Watching the spider's web
—Llanowar expression meaning "focusing on the wrong thing"

quotes.name: Rain of Daggers
quotes.flavor: Knives in the sky, cries in the air, and blood on the ground.

quotes.name: Muscle Sliver
quotes.flavor: The air was filled with the cracks and snaps of flesh hardening as the new sliver joined the battle.

quotes.name: Lu Bu, Master-at-Arms
quotes.flavor: "Dong Zhuo's man, Lu Bu, warrior without peer, / Far surpassed the champions of his sphere."

quotes.name: Ill-Tempered Cyclops
quotes.flavor: A cyclops has two moods: angry and asleep.

quotes.name: Mons's Goblin Raiders
quotes.flavor: The intricate dynamics of Rundvelt Goblin affairs are often confused with anarchy. The chaos, however, is the chaos of a thundercloud, and direction will sporadically and violently appear. Pashalik Mons and his raiders are the thunderhead that leads in the storm.

quotes.name: Dragonmaster Outcast
quotes.flavor: "This world will be ruled by its rightful sovereigns, not these hideous pretenders."

quotes.name: Omenspeaker
quotes.flavor: Her prophecies amaze her even as she speaks them.

quotes.name: Canopy Vista
quotes.flavor: The continent of Murasa lies beneath a blanket of dense vegetation, its enormous branches tangled so thickly that some inhabitants never see the ground.

quotes.name: Tam, Mindful First-Year
quotes.flavor: "What are the odds? And what would you like them to be?"

quotes.name: Shrewd Storyteller
quotes.flavor: All his tales are cautionary.

quotes.name: Frontier Warmonger
quotes.flavor: What could not a warrior do in this hour?

quotes.name: Forgotten Cave
quotes.flavor: In the hearts of mortals, in the pages of ancient lore, in the deep, forgotten places of the universe . . . Chaos awaits.

quotes.name: Mox Emerald
quotes.flavor: 2015 Vintage Championship Winner

quotes.name: Beetle, Legacy Criminal
quotes.flavor: Bored with her humdrum existence, Janice Lincoln sought the thrill of her father's life of crime.

quotes.name: Living Armor
quotes.flavor: Though it affords excellent protection, few don this armor. The process is uncomfortable and not easily reversed.

quotes.name: Elfhame Palace
quotes.flavor: Llanowar has seven elfhames, or kingdoms, each with its own ruler. Their palaces are objects of awe, wonder, and envy.

quotes.name: Make a Stand
quotes.flavor: For a moment they stood tall, all fear forgotten.

quotes.name: Thermo-Alchemist
quotes.flavor: "Madness can't touch a mind ignited by genius."

quotes.name: Marked by Honor
quotes.flavor: Stand your post for duty. Stand your ground for honor.

quotes.name: Aesthir Glider
quotes.flavor: An ancient device recovered from a thawing glacier high in the Karplusan mountains.

quotes.name: Spirit of the Hearth
quotes.flavor: There's comfort and safety in warm, high places.

quotes.name: Light Up the Stage
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor:
"Places, everyone!"
—Judith

quotes.name: Sanitarium Skeleton
quotes.flavor: His mind was lost long before his flesh.

quotes.name: Muraganda Raceway
quotes.flavor: Stage 3: The steaming jungles of Muraganda under falling skies.

quotes.name: Amulet of Kroog
quotes.flavor: Among the first allies Urza gained were the people of Kroog. As a sign of friendship, Urza gave the healers of the city potent amulets; afterwards, thousands journeyed to Kroog in hope of healing, greatly adding to the city's glory.

quotes.name: Circle of Flame
quotes.flavor:
"Which do you think is a better deterrent: a moat of water or one of fire?"
—Chandra Nalaar

quotes.name: Lotuslight Dancers
quotes.flavor: They've attained a level of synchronicity beyond what's possible in a single lifetime.

quotes.name: Wall of Swords
quotes.flavor: Just as the evil ones approached to slay Justina, she cast a great spell, imbuing her weapons with her own life force. Thus she fulfilled the prophecy: "In the death of your savior will you find salvation."

quotes.name: Oneirophage
quotes.flavor: It manifests at wizard academies to siphon inspiration from young prodigies.

quotes.name: Snare Thopter
quotes.flavor:
"I did not think I would understand the cold filigree creatures of this world, but they too are governed by the laws of nature."
—Nissa Revane

quotes.name: Young Necromancer
quotes.flavor: "Who needs imaginary friends when you've got dead ones?"

quotes.name: Slip Out the Back
quotes.flavor: "I was never here."

quotes.name: Thornhide Wolves
quotes.flavor:
"Halana grew brambles to create a barricade around our camp, hoping that it would keep the wolves out. That was a mistake for which we almost paid dearly."
—Alena, trapper of Kessig

quotes.name: Siegfried, Famed Swordsman
quotes.flavor: Recent rumors speak of an impostor that shows up and masquerades as Siegfried himself.

quotes.name: Deathcap Glade
quotes.flavor: Deadly mushrooms litter these woods, each waiting for an errant footstep to release its noxious spores.

quotes.name: Ghalta, Primal Hunger
quotes.flavor: The earth walks, strongest of all.

quotes.name: Thundering Spineback
quotes.flavor:
"It appears that nature has risen against us."
—Captain Brinely Rage

quotes.name: Serra's Boon
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Divine vs. Demonic
quotes.flavor:
"The light of an angel's glance is warm, but her fixed stare blinds and burns."
—Calexis, deacon of the New Order of Serra

quotes.name: Mark of the Vampire
quotes.flavor:
"My 'condition' is a trial. The weak are consumed by it. The strong transcend it."
—Sorin Markov

quotes.name: Outrageous Robbery
quotes.flavor:
"When you can't erase your own trail, leave as many false ones as possible."
—Etrata

quotes.name: Opal Guardian
quotes.flavor: It was a moment in time, cast in stone—a moment whose time had come again.

quotes.name: The Duke of Midrange
quotes.flavor: LETTER

quotes.name: Unnatural Growth
quotes.flavor: With the cycles of day and night unspooled, the twisted sway of the moon only grew. And grew.

quotes.name: Tragedy Feaster
quotes.flavor: In the wake of the archaics' rampage, much worse was to come.

quotes.name: Aether Gale
quotes.flavor: The militia formed up in the central plaza awaiting the onslaught, but the giants never quite made it.

quotes.name: Diabolic Vision
quotes.flavor:
"I have seen the true path. I will not warm myself by the fire—I will become the flame."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

quotes.name: Roving Keep
quotes.flavor:
"It wandered slowly across the landscape, calling out in its lonely voice, but no other castles answered its cries."
—*Beyond the Great Henge*

quotes.name: Expressive Iteration
quotes.flavor: Prismari students dance in the tension between passion and perfection.

quotes.name: Lurking Roper
quotes.flavor: "You see, stalac-*tites* grow down from the ceiling, while stalag-*mites* reach—AAHHHHHHHHH—"

quotes.name: Brass's Bounty
quotes.flavor:
"Why squabble for trinkets when we could be living large off all this gold?"
—Admiral Beckett Brass

quotes.name: Monstrous Rage
quotes.flavor:
「怒りはどこまでも私たちを歪め、壊してしまう。」
――「復讐心とその発露」

quotes.name: Gisela, the Broken Blade // Brisela, Voice of Nightmares
quotes.flavor: "My word is forever shattered."

quotes.name: Glissa Sunseeker
quotes.flavor: To seek the truth was her calling. To gain its power was her destiny.

quotes.name: Teferi's Ageless Insight
quotes.flavor:
"Fine, you know more than me. But do you have to be such a show-off about it?"
—Chandra Nalaar, to Teferi

quotes.name: Quirion Dryad
quotes.flavor:
"Never underestimate the ability of natural forces to adapt to unnatural influences."
—Molimo, maro-sorcerer

quotes.name: Concession Stand
quotes.flavor: Now serving Basri Kettle Corn, Taco Bolas, Karn Dogs, Koth of the Hamburger, Dovin Baan Mi, Oko Cola, Frozen Tamiyogurt, and more!

quotes.name: Imperial Cosmographer
quotes.flavor: "The Supreme Intelligence guides our empire. It requires a constant infusion of knowledge."

quotes.name: Dragon Hunter
quotes.flavor: "Dromoka has taught me the secrets of her kind, that I might use them in her service."

quotes.name: Gift of Orzhova
quotes.flavor:
"Remember by whose gift you ascend."
—Milana, Orzhov prelate

quotes.name: Gavi, Nest Warden
quotes.flavor: A mother's love transcends species.

quotes.name: Ranger's Guile
quotes.flavor:
"You don't survive in the wild by standing in plain sight."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

quotes.name: Trollbred Guardian
quotes.flavor: His favorite food is kraul.

quotes.name: Soulcipher Board // Cipherbound Spirit
quotes.flavor: Rather than consort with demons, the Quietus Cult seeks wisdom from the dead.

quotes.name: Flowstone Surge
quotes.flavor: The army was never at a loss for weapons; Crovax was their forge.

quotes.name: Krark's Thumb
quotes.flavor:
"I can think of *one* goblin it ain't so lucky for."
—Slobad, goblin tinkerer

quotes.name: Blood Seeker
quotes.flavor: A drop now is all he needs to find you later.

quotes.name: Coat of Arms
quotes.flavor:
"Hup, two, three, four,
Dunno how to count no more."
—Mogg march

quotes.name: War Behemoth
quotes.flavor:
"The Houses always hope for peace, but we always pack for war."
—Gvar Barzeel, krumar commander

quotes.name: Raking Claws
quotes.flavor:
"How many claws does a monster have? Exactly one more than you've accounted for."
—Alux, Skysail defender

quotes.name: Soaring Stoneglider
quotes.flavor: "Pranticle Peak is where you get the best views *on land*. I've found an even better vantage!"

quotes.name: Exemplar of Light
quotes.flavor: "I will not rest until you know peace."

quotes.name: Hidetsugu's Second Rite
quotes.flavor: Hidetsugu never relinquished a grudge. He let it burn within him, gathering ever greater intensity until the final moment of vengeance.

quotes.name: Hellkite Whelp
quotes.flavor:
"They play by spitting fire at each other. Don't be offended if one gives you a love-scorch."
—Esfir, Rakdos dragon wrangler

quotes.name: Play with Fire
quotes.flavor: Devils find human dwellings to be oppressively cold, dark, and unburnt.

quotes.name: Forest
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: You're on your way home when you spot the gates of a strange city . . . one that isn't on the map and wasn't here when you traveled this path four days ago.

quotes.name: Swiftfoot Boots
quotes.flavor:
"Start with small, careful steps. I've had customers accidentally jog themselves halfway across the continent in these things."
—Norris, arcane cobbler

quotes.name: Utopia Vow
quotes.flavor: "I'll guard this fruit and its seedling until the land is healed. My life now belongs to Dominaria."

quotes.name: Cultivate
quotes.flavor: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

quotes.name: Desperate Lunge
quotes.flavor: Ravnica held its breath as the hero of the resistance—their last hope—flew through the sky, his dark sword ready to strike a god.

quotes.name: Searslicer Goblin
quotes.flavor: Ikko hadn't intended to start a riot, but now that it was under way, he was having a lot of fun.

quotes.name: Cloud Sprite
quotes.flavor: The delicate sprites carry messages for Saprazzans, but they refuse to land in Mercadia City's filthy markets.

quotes.name: Reckless Embermage
quotes.flavor: Many mages have been consumed by their work.

quotes.name: Azure Mage
quotes.flavor:
"We draw our power from the infinite ocean of the mind, where all manner of things can be conceived."
—Azure creed

quotes.name: Contraband Kingpin
quotes.flavor: "Don't waste my time with trifles. Bring me works of art, and I will make you rich."

quotes.name: Seek the Horizon
quotes.flavor:
"I've seen this great land from every angle. I know its every tree, stone, and river bend. Yet I have come to realize that knowing a thing is not the same as healing it."
—Diary of Azusa

quotes.name: Feldon of the Third Path
quotes.flavor: "She will come back to me."

quotes.name: Hypnotic Specter
quotes.flavor:
"...There was no trace/ Of aught on that illumined face..."
—Samuel Coleridge, "Phantom"

quotes.name: Bastion Protector
quotes.flavor: "By this oath, I pledge to stand by thee, against traitor, beast, or fiend, for only in death does duty end."

quotes.name: Celeborn the Wise
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: His eyes were keen as lances in starlight, and yet profound, the wells of deep memory.

quotes.name: Goblin Shortcutter
quotes.flavor: "I'm not running away! I'm figuring out the best routes."

quotes.name: Muse Drake
quotes.flavor: A composer wrote a symphony based on the drakes screeching outside her window. Reviews were mixed—except among the drakes.

quotes.name: Seat of the Synod
quotes.flavor: Lumengrid, site of the Knowledge Pool, source of vedalken arcana.

quotes.name: Soul Manipulation
quotes.flavor:
"Birth and death are both reversible."
—Nicol Bolas

quotes.name: Malamet Veteran
quotes.flavor: The mightiest Malamet warriors train as titan-killers, elite champions capable of facing down the caverns' most fearsome beasts.

quotes.name: Improbable Alliance
quotes.flavor:
"I agreed to light his way as long as he always had my back."
—Squill, Mistford pixie

quotes.name: The Fifth Doctor
quotes.flavor: "When did you last have the pleasure of smelling a flower, watching a sunset, eating a well-prepared meal?"

quotes.name: Upheaval
quotes.flavor: The calm comes after the storm.

quotes.name: Diabolic Intent
quotes.flavor: Gix pierced his disciples' minds and savored their experiences as he took in their knowledge.

quotes.name: Grapeshot Catapult
quotes.flavor: For years scholars debated whether these were Urza's or Mishra's creations. Recent research suggests they were invented by the brothers' original master, Tocasia, and that both used these devices.

quotes.name: War Screecher
quotes.flavor: Soaring over Vitu-Ghazi, New Prahv, and Orzhova, the Conclave's trained falcons provided critical intelligence.

quotes.name: Fellwar Stone
quotes.flavor:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

quotes.name: Necromancer's Assistant
quotes.flavor: Zombies and necromancers agree: easy access to brains is preferred.

quotes.name: Tireless Tracker
quotes.flavor:
"Tell me, Muse, of that man, so ready at need, who wandered far and wide."
—Homer, *The Odyssey*

quotes.name: Skullcap Snail
quotes.flavor:
"Oh, come on! Aren't regular snails gross enough?"
—Derilene, expedition porter

quotes.name: Isolated Chapel
quotes.flavor: Serra's blessing lies strongest upon Sursi, where her holy chapels are untouched even as the Cabal encroaches.

quotes.name: Spikeshot Elder
quotes.flavor: Now that he knows a thousand ways of hurting people, his next shamanic quest is to discover a thousand more.

quotes.name: Canyon Minotaur
quotes.flavor: On Jund, the deep canyons were the best places to hide. When the goblins wandered into Naya, they found that was not so true.

quotes.name: Collective Unconscious
quotes.flavor: "The beasts of the wild are my senses. It is through their eyes that all knowledge shall come to me."

quotes.name: Storm Entity
quotes.flavor: Dweldian magi don't enter the Realm of Thrones when they die. Instead their souls are drawn to great works of magic.

quotes.name: Learn from the Past
quotes.flavor:
"The Great Ring shall go now to be an heirloom of the North Kingdom; but records of it shall be left in Gondor, lest a time come when the memory of these great matters shall grow dim."
—*Scroll of Isildur*

quotes.name: Swan Song
quotes.flavor: In the end, the dying Illvoi clung to neither secrecy nor protocol. She cloudsculpted wings that she might live on in a spark of creativity.

quotes.name: Merchant of the Vale // Haggle
quotes.flavor: "Buying old, worn out junk. Selling marvels of real value."

quotes.name: Condescend
quotes.flavor: "Shame we'll never see what all the fuss was about."

quotes.name: Ineffable Blessing
quotes.flavor: "Hallowed be this potpourri of sundry goods!"

quotes.name: Stormsurge Kraken
quotes.flavor: Most see krakens as wantonly violent, failing to notice their meticulous attention to detail when dismantling a vessel.

quotes.name: Selesnya Signet
quotes.flavor: The symbol of the Conclave is one of unity, with tree supporting sun and sun feeding tree.

quotes.name: Gatekeeper of Malakir
quotes.flavor: "You may enter the city—once the toll is paid."

quotes.name: Tempest of Light
quotes.flavor: "Let everything return to its true nature, so that destiny may takes its course."

quotes.name: Harmonize
quotes.flavor:
"Animals commune with their environment without the need for language. Theirs is a fundamental connection that surpasses flimsy words."
—Vivien Reid

quotes.name: Propaganda
quotes.flavor:
"You've failed Gerrard. You've failed the Legacy. You've failed yourself. I can do no more."
—Volrath, to Karn

quotes.name: Rite of Harmony
quotes.flavor: Nature bends to the witches' call.

quotes.name: Pia, Determined Rebuilder
quotes.flavor: "We've kept one foot in the past for too long. Now we walk into a better future!"

quotes.name: Arashin Sovereign
quotes.flavor: Dromoka dragons foster trust among their subjects, while the other clans must spend their time quelling rebellion.

quotes.name: Power Armor
quotes.flavor:
"Great peril demands formidable weaponry."
—Urza

quotes.name: Heart Sliver
quotes.flavor: Gerrard looked all around for the source of the mysterious pulse, and at that moment the slivers boiled forth from the crevasses.

quotes.name: Ice Tunnel
quotes.flavor:
"The ice cracked underfoot; strange shapes swam beneath the surface. Who else has walked this blighted path?"
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

quotes.name: Dramatic Rescue
quotes.flavor:
"I never thought I'd be so glad to see two tons of beak and claws bearing down on me at the speed of an arrow."
—Mirela, Azorius hussar

quotes.name: Boros Guildgate
quotes.flavor: Enter with merciful hearts. Exit with battle cries.

quotes.name: Hurricane
quotes.flavor:
"This was quite possibly the least pleasant occurrence on the entire expedition."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

quotes.name: Goblin Chariot
quotes.flavor: The hardest part of his training is learning not to eat the boar.

quotes.name: Mark of the Vampire
quotes.flavor:
"My 'condition' is a trial. The weak are consumed by it. The strong transcend it."
—Sorin Markov

quotes.name: Reckless Reveler
quotes.flavor:
"The gods of Theros are born of the expectations and beliefs of mortals. If I have found godhood, what does that say about their true desires?"
—Xenagos, god of revels

quotes.name: Cowl Prowler
quotes.flavor: Consulate guards who pursue fleeing renegades into the Cowl often become lost—occasionally permanently—in the city's wildest greenbelt.

quotes.name: Undercellar Myconid
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Water, barley, yeast, darkness—the tavern cellar had everything a growing mold could need.

quotes.name: Read the Runes
quotes.flavor: "The world is a puzzle, and the mind is its key."

quotes.name: Sunken Hollow
quotes.flavor: On the continent of Tazeem, rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.

quotes.name: Damia, Sage of Stone
quotes.flavor: Ask your query and be on your way. Just don't look her in the eye.

quotes.name: Nomad Outpost
quotes.flavor:
"Only the weak imprison themselves behind walls. We live free under the wind, and our freedom makes us strong."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

quotes.name: Might of Oaks
quotes.flavor: "Guess where I'm gonna plant this!"

quotes.name: Realms Uncharted
quotes.flavor: The journey is more profound than the destination, but the destination can be pretty great too.

quotes.name: Groundswell
quotes.flavor: "This world will not be tamed."

quotes.name: Fanatical Firebrand
quotes.flavor:
"The Brazen Coalition is a firecannon pointed at our enemies. Goblins like him are the spark to its powder."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

quotes.name: Summit Apes
quotes.flavor:
"If you climb Skyfang Peak, avoid the pass. Generations of apes made that trail, and they don't tolerate trespassers."
—Sachir, Akoum Expeditionary House

quotes.name: Sword of the Animist
quotes.flavor:
"My heart rejoices; for you, Estel, shall be among the great whose valor will destroy the Shadow."
—Arwen

quotes.name: Zombie Apocalypse
quotes.flavor:
"There will come a day so dark you will pray for death. On that day your prayers will be answered."
—Minaldra, the Vizag Atum

quotes.name: Knockout Blow
quotes.flavor: "Subsequent efforts to deconstruct this facility will be punished with increasing severity."

quotes.name: Sunken Hollow
quotes.flavor: On the continent of Tazeem, rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.

quotes.name: In the Web of War
quotes.flavor:
"In desperation, Konda sent warriors to parley with the ogre-magi. No one knows whether they were slaughtered at Shinka or if they even reached its bloodstained walls."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

quotes.name: Army of the Damned
quotes.flavor: Sometimes death comes knocking. Sometimes it tears down the walls.

quotes.name: Shu Elite Companions
quotes.flavor: Throughout the three kingdoms, important generals were often guarded by small groups of expert soldiers known as "elite companions."

quotes.name: Willow-Wind
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: The branches of the willow began to sway violently. Frodo called for help, but he could hardly hear his own voice: it was blown away from him by the willow-wind and drowned in a clamor of leaves.

quotes.name: Pariah's Shield
quotes.flavor: To bear the shield of the pariah is the highest honor a Boros can receive—and the last.

quotes.name: Azorius Keyrune
quotes.flavor:
"The higher the mind soars, the greater its understanding of the law."
—Isperia

quotes.name: Frogmite
quotes.flavor: At first, vedalken observers thought blinkmoths naturally avoided certain places. Then they realized those places were frogmite feeding grounds.

quotes.name: Pulse of the Grid
quotes.flavor: Before labs or lectures, there was insight.

quotes.name: Pit Trap
quotes.flavor:
Never forget your feet
—Elvish expression meaning "watch your step"

quotes.name: Iona, Shield of Emeria
quotes.flavor: No more shall the righteous cower before evil.

quotes.name: Running Is Useless
quotes.flavor: "Yes, flee from me, prey! Flee from your inevitable fate until your feeble mortal body collapses. I will drink my fill of your fear."

quotes.name: Echo Storm
quotes.flavor: An organized and methodical reproduction.

quotes.name: Awakening Zone
quotes.flavor: The ground erupted in time with the hedron's thrum, a dirge of the last days.

quotes.name: Demigod of Revenge
quotes.flavor:
"His laugh, a bellowing, deathly din, slices through the heavens, making them bleed."
—*The Seer's Parables*

quotes.name: Loxodon Warhammer
quotes.flavor:
"A crafter must imbue her weapon with part of her soul—something the Phyrexians are incapable of doing."
—Melira, sylvok outcast

quotes.name: Bladegraft Aspirant
quotes.flavor: "To dance to the music of Juex, leap like the flickering flame and hit like the hammer."

quotes.name: Thaumatic Compass // Spires of Orazca
quotes.flavor:
". . . a cryptic objective."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: United Battlefront
quotes.flavor: The Abzan forces rallied to the call, driving back Sarkhan's feral dragon horde.

quotes.name: Stroke of Genius
quotes.flavor: After a hundred failed experiments, Urza was stunned to find that common silver passed through the portal undamaged. He immediately designed a golem made of the metal.

quotes.name: Abuelo, Ancestral Echo
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Promos
quotes.flavor: "Come, friends. Let us see if this world remembers us."

quotes.name: Ghoulish Procession
quotes.flavor: It was a family reunion to die for.

quotes.name: Sandsteppe Citadel
quotes.flavor:
"The most important part of a stronghold isn't its armaments or its walls. It's the reason people have to defend it."
—Gvar Barzeel, krumar captain

quotes.name: Kiora's Dambreaker
quotes.flavor:
"When your enemy flees, send the sea to pursue them."
—Kiora

quotes.name: Inspired Charge
quotes.flavor:
"For the lands you have lost and the beauty that remains, for freedom and the future, we must hold nothing back!"
—Gideon Jura

quotes.name: Ur-Golem's Eye
quotes.flavor: It still stares accusingly at Memnarch, though millennia have passed since he separated the eye from its body.

quotes.name: Zhur-Taa Druid
quotes.flavor: "Only the decadent think magic should be pristine and without cost."

quotes.name: Bladebrand
quotes.flavor: "One knife, two knives, three knives, four—which will drop you to the floor?"

quotes.name: Baneslayer Angel
quotes.flavor: Some angels protect the meek and innocent. Others seek out and smite evil wherever it lurks.

quotes.name: Unchecked Growth
quotes.flavor:
"That energy was once granted to growing things. Now the kami keep it for themselves, releasing it in sudden floods that overwhelm flesh and foliage alike."
—Sakiko, Mother of Summer

quotes.name: Verdant Force
quotes.flavor: Left to itself, nature overflows any container, overthrows any restriction, and overreaches any boundary.

quotes.name: Lux Cannon
quotes.flavor: There are few problems that can't be solved by putting a hole in the world.

quotes.name: Magmaw
quotes.flavor:
"The purpose of existence is simple: everything is fuel for the magmaw."
—Jaji, magmaw worshipper

quotes.name: Mnemonic Deluge
quotes.flavor: Past, present, and future surged through the wizard's mind, bringing a flood of possibilities.

quotes.name: Revealing Wind
quotes.flavor:
"The sands obscure the vision of others, but clarify ours."
—Faiso, Dromoka commander

quotes.name: Beast Hunt
quotes.flavor:
"Surely we could tame something besides hurdas and pillarfield oxen!"
—Sheyda, Ondu gamekeeper

quotes.name: Gamble
quotes.flavor:
"STUFF AND SUNDRIES AND MUNITIONS!"
—Breeches, gunner of the *Belligerent*

quotes.name: Valiant Guard
quotes.flavor: As the outsiders invaded Bant, soldiers who once saw sigils as the highest marks of glory began to see the scars of battle as tokens of equal worth.

quotes.name: Volcanic Dragon
quotes.flavor:
"That's no ordinary eruption!"
—Grazlash Stonehold, last words

quotes.name: Shriek, Treblemaker
quotes.flavor: Exposure to the Darkforce dimension left Frances Barrison craving chaos and carnage.

quotes.name: Imperious Perfect
quotes.flavor: In a culture of beauty, the most beautiful are worshipped as gods.

quotes.name: Diversionary Tactics
quotes.flavor: "It's the oldest trick in the book," said Guff. "And I ought to know—I wrote it."

quotes.name: Academy Manufactor
quotes.flavor: It shapes wonders beyond our wildest dreams—like sandwiches.

quotes.name: Ayara, Widow of the Realm // Ayara, Furnace Queen
quotes.flavor: Ayara cherished her new machine servitors just as much as she once did her many suitors: not at all.

quotes.name: Rosethorn Acolyte // Seasonal Ritual
quotes.flavor: "Old battlefields make great gardens. So rich from the blood of the fallen."

quotes.name: Soul Feast
quotes.flavor: You are who you eat.

quotes.name: Fortified Village
quotes.flavor:
"On the fields of Trenzalore, he stood as protector both of his own people and his new home."
—Tasha Lem

quotes.name: Counterspell
quotes.flavor: "How pathetic! To Doom, even your best efforts are an embarrassment!"

quotes.name: Armory of Iroas
quotes.flavor: Each weapon is as unique as the champion who carried it to battle.

quotes.name: Echo Storm
quotes.flavor: An organized and methodical reproduction.

quotes.name: Nephalia Drownyard
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor:
"Some see a coastal disaster. I see a fully-stocked seagraf."
—Jadar, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

quotes.name: Remand
quotes.flavor: "Well, at least all of that arm-waving and arcane babbling you did was impressive."

quotes.name: Dive Down
quotes.flavor: "Seeing the river is not the same as seeing the fish."

quotes.name: Draugr Thought-Thief
quotes.flavor: The worst part is that you won't even remember how much he's taken from you.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Arena
quotes.flavor: A drop of humanity for a sea of power.

quotes.name: Grime Gorger
quotes.flavor: Sometimes the trash throws you out.

quotes.name: Fallow Earth
quotes.flavor:
". . . and when the farmer awoke the next morning, all the seeds from his field were once again in their sacks."
—Afari, *Tales*

quotes.name: Join Shields
quotes.flavor: "We are the shield that never breaks, the bough that never burns, the song that can never be silenced."

quotes.name: Sunblast Angel
quotes.flavor: There may exist powers even greater than Phyrexia.

quotes.name: Late to Dinner
quotes.flavor: "I knew you were set in your ways, friend, but even I didn't expect you to keep our engagement, under the circumstances."

quotes.name: Angel of the God-Pharaoh
quotes.flavor: The angels did not deceive. From the start, they were clear their allegiance was to the God-Pharaoh and to him alone.

quotes.name: Tower Drake
quotes.flavor: Young tower drakes quickly learn to maneuver among Benalia's many spires.

quotes.name: Despark
quotes.flavor: Liliana whispered to whatever consciousness Oketra and Bontu had left. "You are the gods. He is the usurper. You know what to do."

quotes.name: Arcane Signet
quotes.flavor: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

quotes.name: Winter Blast
quotes.flavor:
"Blow, winds, and crack your cheeks! rage! blow!"
—William Shakespeare, *King Lear*

quotes.name: Oakenform
quotes.flavor:
"When the beast cloaks itself in the mighty oak, what good is a bow? When the oak wraps itself around the snarling beast, what good is a hatchet?"
—Dionus, elvish archdruid

quotes.name: Zephid's Embrace
quotes.flavor: Spells will shun you, as will everyone else.

quotes.name: Release the Dogs
quotes.flavor: They charge into battle and out for their morning walk with the same exuberance.

quotes.name: Agent of Stromgald
quotes.flavor:
"The 'fabled' Order of Stromgald is cast to the four winds, lost for all time. I, for one, give them no thought."
—General Varchild

quotes.name: Ring of Renewal
quotes.flavor: To the uninitiated, the Ring of Renewal is merely an oddity. For those fluent in the wielding of magic, however, it is a source of great knowledge.

quotes.name: Captivating Crew
quotes.flavor: "We sail. We plunder. Then we dance."

quotes.name: Opt
quotes.flavor: Teferi had once wielded the power—and hubris—of a god. To fix his mistakes, he would risk everything.

quotes.name: Joraga Invocation
quotes.flavor:
"A single tree does not a forest make. We are stronger when we stand together."
—Numa, Joraga chieftain

quotes.name: Nirkana Assassin
quotes.flavor: Nirkana assassins craft incurable concoctions by mixing basilisk marrow and deathwillow sap with the vital fluids of a dozen other poisonous species.

quotes.name: Worldly Tutor
quotes.flavor: Wisdom is a seed. Nurtured with patience and care, it will bear new fruit each season.

quotes.name: Patron of the Valiant
quotes.flavor: "Bant's most gallant knights wear my sigil, and for that I am humbled."

quotes.name: Lava Axe
quotes.flavor: It can chop down a redwood in a single stroke. Your sternum isn't going to fare any better.

quotes.name: Archetype of Aggression
quotes.flavor:
"Did Purphoros bless Maikal because of his rage? Or did Maikal's rage blossom after he'd been blessed? Only the gods know."
—Eocles, oracle of Purphoros

quotes.name: Mortify
quotes.flavor: Many who cross Sorin's path come down with a sudden and fatal case of being-in-the-way-of-a-millennia-old-vampire.

quotes.name: Scavenger Grounds
quotes.flavor: The only things you need out in the wastes are food, water, and bullets. Everything else is details.

quotes.name: Weave Fate
quotes.flavor: Destiny is a flickering path among tangled possibilities.

quotes.name: Hurloon Shaman
quotes.flavor:
"I believe it when they say they're connected to the land—looks like somebody plowed her face."
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Vega, the Watcher
quotes.flavor: One eye sees the past, one the present, and one the future—and none can be deceived.

quotes.name: Silverquill Campus
quotes.flavor: Mage-students drawn to the power of language choose Silverquill, the college of eloquence.

quotes.name: White Sun's Zenith
quotes.flavor: After the Battle of Liet Field, the white sun crested above Taj-Nar, bringing hope to all who survived the carnage.

quotes.name: Thrill of Possibility
quotes.flavor:
"The most delicious ingredients are often the most dangerous to obtain."
—Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar, *The Underworld Cookbook*

quotes.name: Shadowblood Ridge
quotes.flavor: Gnolls make offerings to sinister forces in the shadow-drenched chasms.

quotes.name: Reaver Drone
quotes.flavor: Kozilek's brood infiltrates and deceives. The spawn of Ulamog mindlessly consume.

quotes.name: Bonders' Enclave
quotes.flavor:
"With things the way they are now, how 'bout raising a chocobo?"
—Chocobo Bill

quotes.name: Buried Ruin
quotes.flavor: History has buried its treasures deep.

quotes.name: Baleful Ammit
quotes.flavor:
"Not all in our crop deserve the afterlife. We must leave the unworthy behind, Samut."
—Djeru, initiate of Tah crop

quotes.name: Carry Away
quotes.flavor: Stealing goblin weapons would be easier if the goblins were smart enough to let go.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Gargantua
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Phyrexia vs. the Coalition
quotes.flavor: Other Phyrexians have nightmares about the gargantua.

quotes.name: Worship
quotes.flavor:
"Believe in the ideal, not the idol."
—Serra

quotes.name: Long-Forgotten Gohei
quotes.flavor: Long ago, the priests would wave the gohei to call down the gods. Now it lies forgotten, but the spirits still feel its pull.

quotes.name: Codespell Cleric
quotes.flavor: "Today we are not Beskir or Tuskeri. We must fight as one clan, shoulder to shoulder, to defend our rightful home!"

quotes.name: Mischievous Pup
quotes.flavor:
"Either he made a gnome very angry when he took that, or he'll make one very happy when he brings it back."
—Ihio, Oteclan market vendor

quotes.name: Ornithopter
quotes.flavor:
"It has been my honor to improve on the Thran's original design. Perhaps history will remember me in some small part for my work."
—Urza, in his apprenticeship

quotes.name: Olivia's Dragoon
quotes.flavor: Displays of Voldaren bloodlust are not restricted to glamorous banquets and lavish parties.

quotes.name: Blade Splicer
quotes.flavor: "Flesh is a betrayal of the self."

quotes.name: Manta Riders
quotes.flavor:
"Water is firmament to the finned."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

quotes.name: Mold Folk
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor:
"Corpses of those slain by russet mold grow new moldies. Not the legacy most of us aspire to."
—Elminster

quotes.name: Might of the Nephilim
quotes.flavor:
"Send a runner to Tin Street, and tell 'em the delivery has been . . . uh . . . held up."
—Bonmod, caravan rear guard

quotes.name: Bishop of the Bloodstained
quotes.flavor: "They shall give us all they have as penance for their resistance. Their ships. Their goods. Their rebellious blood."

quotes.name: Fire Drake
quotes.flavor: Brimstone marks this drake's territory. Unfortunately for travelers, all of the Burning Isles smell likewise.

quotes.name: Braids, Conjurer Adept
quotes.flavor: The rifted multiverse became a sea of conflicting realities, each peopled by possible versions of every living being.

quotes.name: Terrifying Presence
quotes.flavor: Elmut had slaughtered vampires, slain werewolves, and destroyed hordes of zombies. Sadly, he never got over his fear of spiders.

quotes.name: Giant Strength
quotes.flavor: "Crovax seems filled only with shadows," thought Orim. "Where does his strength come from?"

quotes.name: Delusions of Mediocrity
quotes.flavor: When nothing but second best will do.

quotes.name: Soul's Fire
quotes.flavor: An avatar he sculpts of anger and flame.

quotes.name: Homarid Shaman
quotes.flavor:
"The ground grew swampy; hooves and claws sank into the marshy earth. Snarls of rage and bleats of despair echoed through the trees as the waters grew higher and higher."
—Kyliki of Havenwood, "Havenwood Remembered"

quotes.name: Gnawing Zombie
quotes.flavor: On still nights you can hear its rotted teeth grinding tirelessly on scavenged bones.

quotes.name: Boros Signet
quotes.flavor:
"Have you ever held a Boros signet? There's a weight to it that belies its size—a weight of strength and of pride."
—Agrus Kos

quotes.name: Deeproot Wayfinder
quotes.flavor: Her warning raced through the roots and rivers of Ixalan: prepare for war.

quotes.name: Lat-Nam Adept
quotes.flavor: "Every book is a doorway to enlightenment. Curiosity is your key."

quotes.name: Celestial Ancient
quotes.flavor:
"We thought the clouds had moved from the night sky. Then the night sky moved, and the horizon grew wings."
—Josuri

quotes.name: Corrupted Conviction
quotes.flavor:
"For the good of all, those who stand against the harmony of Phyrexia must be cut down."
—Ajani Goldmane

quotes.name: Red XIII, Proud Warrior
quotes.flavor: "I am Nanaki, Watcher of Cosmo Canyon... and son of Seto!"

quotes.name: Titanic Growth
quotes.flavor: The pup looked over the treetops, eyeing the man who just yesterday had kicked her. Suddenly, her hunger was infused with pure delight.

quotes.name: Chromatic Lantern
quotes.flavor: "Koh-koh noo-lahs boh ay-loh dah-noh-lah."

quotes.name: Null Caller
quotes.flavor: Zendikar's defenders include both healers and vampires. One way or another, the fallen will return to the fight.

quotes.name: Blasphemous Act
quotes.flavor:
"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

quotes.name: Razaketh, the Foulblooded
quotes.flavor: Liliana insisted on coming to Amonkhet to confront one of the two remaining demons to whom she is bound.

quotes.name: Invisibility
quotes.flavor: Verick held his breath. Breathing wouldn't reveal his position, but it would force him to smell the goblins.

quotes.name: Ainok Wayfarer
quotes.flavor: "There has to be a faster route through Sagu Jungle. Give me a week."

quotes.name: Gaea's Bounty
quotes.flavor: The forest grew back so quickly that lumbering machines were suspended in the treetops.

quotes.name: Rite of Flame
quotes.flavor: As the flames engulfed her, Chandra opened her heart and offered up her greatest regrets to be consumed by the inferno.

quotes.name: Stigma Lasher
quotes.flavor: The Extinguisher's curse lasted long after her departure.

quotes.name: Possession Engine
quotes.flavor: "Here's a tip: If your ride needs souls for fuel, make sure to always keep one handy."

quotes.name: Inevitable Defeat
quotes.flavor:
"We came seeking a challenge. It seems we must continue searching."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

quotes.name: Teferi's Time Twist
quotes.flavor: "The safest place for you is not now."

quotes.name: Wakandan Royal Guard
quotes.flavor: The shields and spears of Wakanda are forever united in defense of their king.

quotes.name: Empowered Autogenerator
quotes.flavor: Magic, unlike physics, has no unbreakable laws.

quotes.name: Scute Mob
quotes.flavor:
"Survival rule 781: There are always more scute bugs."
—Zurdi, goblin shortcutter

quotes.name: Eelectrocute
quotes.flavor: The midway's games aren't so much rigged as they are insulated and grounded.

quotes.name: Five-Finger Discount
quotes.flavor: "Dognapping is such an ugly word. I would characterize this as a unilateral redistribution of pets."

quotes.name: Martial Coup
quotes.flavor: Elder Nolan McNamara broke the Chain That Binds, starting the events which led to Hardin's coup.

quotes.name: Merchant Scroll
quotes.flavor: A rare find, suitable for the most discerning collector.

quotes.name: Decoction Module
quotes.flavor: Progress leads to inspiration.

quotes.name: Bonecrusher Giant // Stomp
quotes.flavor: Not every tale ends in glory.

quotes.name: Vengeful Dead
quotes.flavor: Those who don't learn from their deaths are destined to repeat them.

quotes.name: Holy Light
quotes.flavor: "Bathed in hallowed light, the infidels looked upon the impurities of their souls and despaired." —*The Book of Tal*

quotes.name: Sai, Master Thopterist
quotes.flavor: "Industry without artistry is just a fancy way to fill the junkyard."

quotes.name: Star of Extinction
quotes.flavor:
"The visions haunt me. I see the end of the world, brought on by the search for the Immortal Sun."
—Shaper Pashona

quotes.name: Manifold Key
quotes.flavor:
"Locks want to be opened, and treasure wants to be free."
—Nayrex Slipfinger, master thief

quotes.name: Persist
quotes.flavor: In the tight-knit doun of Mistmeadow, death is less important than duty.

quotes.name: Horizon Seed
quotes.flavor: In peaceful times, these beings escorted the honored kami to their new shrines. In the Kami War, they became the medics of an unstoppable army.

quotes.name: Tormenting Voice
quotes.flavor: "You are undeserving of the afterlife. You will never feel the God-Pharaoh's embrace."

quotes.name: Festercreep
quotes.flavor: A single festercreep isn't alone. It's already an infestation.

quotes.name: Consulate Crackdown
quotes.flavor:
"The workshops are silent. Our creations have been seized. They have killed what made us alive."
—Pia Nalaar

quotes.name: Aang's Defense
quotes.flavor:
"I guess you've never fought an Airbender before."
—Aang

quotes.name: Scorned Villager // Moonscarred Werewolf
quotes.flavor: ". . . and I will bring the fury of the wild back to my village."

quotes.name: Gallia of the Endless Dance
quotes.flavor: "There's no success like excess!"

quotes.name: Dictate of Heliod
quotes.flavor:
"In our war Heliod gave mortals some favor, yet other times he withheld aid. Are we still no more than game pieces to him?"
—Polyxene the Doubter

quotes.name: Skullclamp
quotes.flavor: The mind is a beautiful bounty encased in an annoying bone container.

quotes.name: Vodalian Soldiers
quotes.flavor:
"The cooling climate introduced a new threat to Vodalia: the Homarids. Once a minor nuisance, they thrived in the changing environment. Their ceaseless attacks strained Vodalia's defenses to their limit, eventually overwhelming the empire."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. V*

quotes.name: Child of Thorns
quotes.flavor:
"The soratami scoff at the perils of Jukai, calling the forest an 'unruly garden.' Perhaps we should send them a rose such as this."
—Dokai, Weaver of Life

quotes.name: Floodtide Serpent
quotes.flavor:
"Pray to Thassa for *what*? A bigger monster to eat it? A wave that can wash it away? What then?"
—Lindos, merchant of Meletis

quotes.name: Goblin Medics
quotes.flavor:
"First, do some harm."
—Oath of Goblins

quotes.name: Deadly Rollick
quotes.flavor: "I normally charge for my merc services, but I just can't say no to someone who controls their commander."

quotes.name: Sign in Blood
quotes.flavor: Little agonies pave the way to greater power.

quotes.name: Floodfarm Verge
quotes.flavor: Here, the Mistmoors slump like a grieving parent, the once-thriving fields drowned by the relentless deluge.

quotes.name: Answered Prayers
quotes.flavor: Angels cannot ignore pious pleas.

quotes.name: Temple of the False God
quotes.flavor: Those who bring nothing to the temple take nothing away.

quotes.name: Smashing Success
quotes.flavor:
"Who said there's no profit in destruction?"
—Magda, brazen outlaw

quotes.name: Negate
quotes.flavor: "As one, nature lifts its voice to tell you this: 'No.'"

quotes.name: Excavation Technique
quotes.flavor: "Stand back. This part gets messy."

quotes.name: Lightning Runner
quotes.flavor: "Catch me if you can."

quotes.name: Champion of Arashin
quotes.flavor: "The blood of Dromoka and the blood of my veins are the same."

quotes.name: Rune-Brand Juggler
quotes.flavor: Notice: Guests of Hellbender may be exposed to occasional bursts of flame.

quotes.name: Totally Lost
quotes.flavor: Fblthp had always hated crowds.

quotes.name: Bant Charm
quotes.flavor: Bant is a world where death and chaos hold no sway.

quotes.name: Guardian of Solitude
quotes.flavor:
"It seemed an easy thing, to step into the nothingness, to fall, to die. But then, for an instant, I saw it, eyes filled with endless sorrow, and I turned back to face my pain."
—Snow-Fur, kitsune poet

quotes.name: Denethor, Stone Seer
quotes.flavor: "You may triumph on the field, for a day. But against the Power that now arises there is no victory."

quotes.name: Azorius Guildgate
quotes.flavor: Enter the Senate, the seat of justice and the foundation of Ravnican society.

quotes.name: Ultimate Green Goblin
quotes.flavor: Osborn's lust for power was nothing short of monstrous.

quotes.name: Elvish Archdruid
quotes.flavor: "The elves tend the forest, and the forest sustains the elves. My role is to ensure that the cycle continues."

quotes.name: Cloudshift
quotes.flavor:
"Even storm clouds bow to worship Avacyn."
—Elder Rimheit

quotes.name: Transmogrant's Crown
quotes.flavor: Fallaji soldiers hated seeing loved ones' faces among the transmogrants. Ashnod devised a solution.

quotes.name: Pilgrim's Eye
quotes.flavor: The kor send their thopter kites to see if the land is in a welcoming mood.

quotes.name: Sea Sprite
quotes.flavor:
"No one can catch what won't be caught."
—Kakra, Sea Troll

quotes.name: Aggressive Mining
quotes.flavor: Creation. Destruction. Creation. Destruction. Creation. Destruction. Destruction. Destruction. Destruction.

quotes.name: Electrodominance
quotes.flavor: "Basically, we turn a bunch of little lightnings into one big lightning."

quotes.name: Uril, the Miststalker
quotes.flavor: It strides through the whitecover, mists in which even gargantuans can hide.

quotes.name: With Great Power . . .
quotes.flavor: . . . there must also come great responsibility!

quotes.name: Forest
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: You continue to mutter and complain as you trip over yet another gnarled root. From behind the nearest tree trunk, something mutters back.

quotes.name: Path to Exile
quotes.flavor: Her resentment vanished as strange, unknown lands opened up before her.

quotes.name: Blustersquall
quotes.flavor: Weather is more predictable than the Izzet.

quotes.name: Phantasmal Bear
quotes.flavor:
"You know it to be false, but when its claws find you, what you know won't matter much at all."
—Pol Jamaar, illusionist

quotes.name: Blighted Cataract
quotes.flavor: Once, water ran here. Now only dust and ash fall from the clifftops.

quotes.name: Puncturing Blow
quotes.flavor:
"Neither the false God-Pharaoh nor his bugs will decide our fate."
—Samut, former Tah-crop initiate

quotes.name: Early Frost
quotes.flavor: Under its mists, the earth sleeps.

quotes.name: Game Trail
quotes.flavor:
"Every hour of sunlight that feeds it makes the world darker, and the beast stronger."
—The Twelfth Doctor

quotes.name: Spiketail Drakeling
quotes.flavor: Drakelings fish with their tails, angling to snare succulent thoughts and memories on their psychic hooks.

quotes.name: Brothers of Fire
quotes.flavor: Fire is never a gentle master.

quotes.name: Forsaken Sanctuary
quotes.flavor: In the galleon's grand cathedral, conquistadors swore vows of faith. In its wreckage, they swore vows of revenge.

quotes.name: Lightning Axe
quotes.flavor: Spirits disturbed by ghoulcallers become geists driven by restless anger.

quotes.name: Fusion Elemental
quotes.flavor: As the shards merged into the Maelstrom, their mana energies fused into new monstrosities.

quotes.name: Path of Peace
quotes.flavor: As Hedrax stepped into oblivion, he welcomed the unwavering silence.

quotes.name: Arcane Signet
quotes.flavor: Something to love, honor, and cherish—and a reminder of someone who once did that for you.

quotes.name: Needlepeak Spider
quotes.flavor:
"It's a testament to the forests' devastation that giant spiders now make their homes amid Dominaria's barren spires."
—Aznaph, greenseeker

quotes.name: Morkrut Banshee
quotes.flavor:
"Let go your grudges, or risk wandering the bogs forever in a murderous rage."
—Hildin, priest of Avacyn

quotes.name: Hymn to Tourach
quotes.flavor:
"Tourach's power was such that his followers deified him after his death."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. II*

quotes.name: Warped Tusker
quotes.flavor: Once, foraging for truffles, the very average boar fell asleep beneath the moon . . . .

quotes.name: Chandra's Ignition
quotes.flavor: In the moment before her execution, she realized what it meant to be a pyromancer, to be alive, to be Chandra.

quotes.name: Seal of Cleansing
quotes.flavor:
"I am the purifier, the light that clears all shadows."
—Seal inscription

quotes.name: Terra Stomper
quotes.flavor: Sometimes violent earthquakes, hurtling boulders, and unseasonable dust storms are wrongly attributed to the Roil.

quotes.name: Anointer of Champions
quotes.flavor: "Arise. You have been anointed by the light. Go forth and fight without fear, for you shall be victorious."

quotes.name: Unlucky Cabbage Merchant
quotes.flavor: "My cabbages!"

quotes.name: Thriss, Nantuko Primus
quotes.flavor: "When you live for others, you live for yourself."

quotes.name: Mercurial Chemister
quotes.flavor: What some see as "distracted" is really "fathoming the unfathomable."

quotes.name: Rotten Reunion
quotes.flavor: Aunt and Uncle Greyfeld loved dinner guests.

quotes.name: Riverglide Pathway // Lavaglide Pathway
quotes.flavor:
"The wind knows the way. Just let it carry you there."
—Amandi, kitesail expert

quotes.name: Angelic Wall
quotes.flavor:
"The air stirred as if fanned by angels' wings, and the enemy was turned aside."
—Tales of Ikarov the Voyager

quotes.name: Wings of the Guard
quotes.flavor: Within the city walls, Adriana's falcons hunt vermin of all kinds.

quotes.name: War Mammoth
quotes.flavor: I didn't think Mammoths could ever hold a candle to a well-trained battle horse. Then one day I turned my back on a drunken soldier. His blow never landed; Mi'cha flung the brute over ten meters.

quotes.name: Mystic Melting
quotes.flavor: The sun-hot glow radiated from the druids, leaving scattered metal in steaming pools as it passed.

quotes.name: Adarkar Wastes
quotes.flavor: Left barren by the Brothers' War, it stands as a stark reminder of Dominaria's likely fate should the Coalition fail.

quotes.name: Mirari's Wake
quotes.flavor: The land drank power from the Mirari as though it had thirsted forever.

quotes.name: Trespasser il-Vec
quotes.flavor: At the epicenter of the Rathi overlay, the City of Traitors did not align with Dominaria. Many of its inhabitants were caught between the two worlds.

quotes.name: Kjeldoran Elite Guard
quotes.flavor: The winged helms of the guard are put on for pageants—but taken off for war.

quotes.name: Mortuary
quotes.flavor:
"Think of them not as failures but as works in progress."
—Volrath

quotes.name: Misers' Cage
quotes.flavor:
"Let him be imprisoned while his possessions wander free."
—Suq'Ata legal decree

quotes.name: Rakdos Signet
quotes.flavor: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

quotes.name: Steadfastness
quotes.flavor: Brute force wins the battles. Conviction wins the wars.

quotes.name: Embereth Shieldbreaker // Battle Display
quotes.flavor: "Courage is the only shield I need."

quotes.name: Forge Devil
quotes.flavor: Devils infiltrated the lower levels of Thraben Cathedral, making cracks in load-bearing pillars and setting fire to precious archives.

quotes.name: In the Trenches
quotes.flavor: The battlefield became so pockmarked with craters and trenches that casualties were regularly attributed to "fell in a hole."

quotes.name: Unmake
quotes.flavor: A gwyllion's favorite trap is the vanity mirror. A bewitched piece of glass traps the looker's soul and does away with the body.

quotes.name: Heartstone
quotes.flavor:
"Finding a true heartstone is even harder than finding a true heart."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

quotes.name: Katara, Waterbending Master
quotes.flavor: "The strength of your heart makes you who you are."

quotes.name: Mortician Beetle
quotes.flavor: To the soldier, war is famine; to the scavenger, a feast.

quotes.name: Abrupt Decay
quotes.flavor: The Izzet quickly suspended their policy of lifetime guarantees.

quotes.name: Unexpectedly Absent
quotes.flavor: Once you've been dragged down the currents of time, you'll never quite trust your own permanence again.

quotes.name: Borderland Marauder
quotes.flavor: Though she is rightly feared, there are relatively few tales of her deeds in battle, for few survive her raids.

quotes.name: Urza's Tower
quotes.flavor: Urza always put Tocasia's lessons on resource-gathering to effective use.

quotes.name: Arashin Sunshield
quotes.flavor:
"The best way to protect the citizens is to defend Arashin, not hunt dragonstorms across Tarkir."
—Sadesh of House Mevak

quotes.name: Silklash Spider
quotes.flavor: The only thing that flies over the Krosan Forest is the wind.

quotes.name: Celestial Force
quotes.flavor:
"Wishing upon only one star seems like a failure of imagination."
—Vish Kal, Blood Arbiter

quotes.name: Foreboding Statue // Forsaken Thresher
quotes.flavor: As the sand eroded, a faint sound could be heard whirling under the ground.

quotes.name: Circuit Mender
quotes.flavor: Inspired by industrious silkworms, its maker crafted it to restore the broken pieces of the world.

quotes.name: Undead Sprinter
quotes.flavor: Farley had always been the fastest on the track team. But no one was cheering anymore.

quotes.name: Ayula, Queen Among Bears
quotes.flavor: Born from the oldest red cedar, nursed on the sap of the tallest spruce, coronated under the mightiest pine.

quotes.name: The Rebellious Intelligence
quotes.flavor: FEWER

quotes.name: Bravado
quotes.flavor:
"We drive the dragons from our home. Why should we fear you?"
—Fire Eye, viashino bey

quotes.name: Meteor Golem
quotes.flavor: A mechanical monster equipped with a massive arsenal of weapons and attacks, including its signature Wave Cannon.

quotes.name: Forsaken Monument
quotes.flavor:
"We shall forever roam."
—Ayli, high priest of the Eternal Pilgrims

quotes.name: Voldaren Pariah // Abolisher of Bloodlines
quotes.flavor: Even if the rain turned to blood, her thirst would not be slaked.

quotes.name: An Incident Has Occurred
quotes.flavor: "So sorry, but, per our waiver, we're not responsible for 'things happening.'"

quotes.name: Despark
quotes.flavor: "The rains have ceased, and we have been graced with another beautiful day. But you are not here to see it."

quotes.name: Fists of Ironwood
quotes.flavor: Saprolings add the three and the four to the "one-two punch."

quotes.name: Turn Inside Out
quotes.flavor: "Scared, are you? Need a hug?"

quotes.name: Mephitic Vapors
quotes.flavor: Ravnica's safest strongholds are often neither.

quotes.name: Ashnod
quotes.flavor: Ashnod served as Mishra's confidante while he led Fallaji weapons development before the Brothers' War. Whereas Mishra works in metals and stone, however, Ashnod works in living flesh. She sees all living things as prototype machines; her "improvements" to them make her as feared by allies as by enemies.

quotes.name: Double Down
quotes.flavor: The best alibi is being in multiple places at the same time.

quotes.name: Knight of the Tusk
quotes.flavor: "Horse? Who needs a horse?"

quotes.name: Penregon Strongbull
quotes.flavor: His child-lifting act was second only to his cauldron-punting routine.

quotes.name: Deadbeat Attendant
quotes.flavor: Some people will hire anyone with a pulse. Myra isn't that picky.

quotes.name: Darksteel Plate
quotes.flavor:
"If there can be no victory, then I will fight forever."
—Koth of the Hammer

quotes.name: Tundra Wolves
quotes.flavor: I heard their eerie howling, the wolves calling their kindred across the frozen plains.

quotes.name: Brotherhood Vertibird
quotes.flavor: As tough as the armored troops it carries.

quotes.name: Bedevil
quotes.flavor: On that day... the world was changed forever...

quotes.name: Talon Sliver
quotes.flavor: "Keep them at sword's length!" Gerrard's order fell flat as each sliver's talon suddenly grew longer. "Hold on—break out the polearms!"

quotes.name: Divination
quotes.flavor: "Ask of Keranos that you may understand the stars that mark your destiny. Implore Erebos that you may accept the fate thus divulged."

quotes.name: Ghirapur Gearcrafter
quotes.flavor: The metal must be pure. The hand must be steady. The product must be perfect.

quotes.name: Whipcorder
quotes.flavor: His bolas whirl like galaxies, but it's his enemies who see stars.

quotes.name: Pendelhaven
quotes.flavor:
"This is the forest primeval. The murmuring pines and the hemlocks . . . Stand like Druids of eld."
—Henry Wadsworth Longfellow, "Evangeline"

quotes.name: Savannah Lions
quotes.flavor:
Even the brave are scared by a lion three times: first by its tracks, again by its roar, and one last time face to face.
—Somali proverb

quotes.name: Ashnod's Altar
quotes.flavor:
"If you work at sawing up carcasses, you notice how the joints fit, how the nerves are arrayed, and how the skin peels back."
—Ashnod, to Tawnos

quotes.name: Doom Blade
quotes.flavor: The void is without substance but cuts like steel.

quotes.name: Erudite Wizard
quotes.flavor: "Pretty baubles and gilded palaces may appeal to the egotist, but true wealth comes only through knowledge."

quotes.name: Zhalfirin Void
quotes.flavor:
"The wind whispers, 'come home,' but I cannot."
—Teferi

quotes.name: Horrific Assault
quotes.flavor: With shifting forms and no angel to pray to, Innistrad's werewolves were especially susceptible to Emrakul's influence.

quotes.name: Painful Truths
quotes.flavor: As the Eldrazi spread, no secret that could give Zendikar's defenders an advantage was considered too dangerous to seek.

quotes.name: Angelic Blessing
quotes.flavor: Only the warrior who can admit mortal weakness will be bolstered by immortal strength.

quotes.name: Feed the Swarm
quotes.flavor:
"On vile wings and bloody wind, the swarm will rise."
—Skyclave inscription

quotes.name: Breath of Dreams
quotes.flavor:
"Get up, blast you! They're attacking! Why are you all so slow?"
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

quotes.name: Loam Lion
quotes.flavor: In Zendikar, today's grassland could be tomorrow's jungle, and hunting grounds change as quickly as the weather.

quotes.name: Umbral Collar Zealot
quotes.flavor: "All things will fall to the Zero Point. By accepting this truth, my path is known and my fate is certain."

quotes.name: Malcator's Watcher
quotes.flavor: Each of the Gitaxian sectives watches the others, looking for any hint of imperfection.

quotes.name: Terrasymbiosis
quotes.flavor: For Eumidians, terraforming and evolution are one and the same. They grow as their planet grows, in lockstep coexistence.

quotes.name: Mycosynth Wellspring
quotes.flavor: The oil created the mycosynth. The mycosynth created New Phyrexia.

quotes.name: One with Nothing
quotes.flavor: When nothing remains, everything is equally possible.

quotes.name: Wonder
quotes.flavor:
"The awestruck birds gazed at Wonder. Slowly, timidly, they rose into the air."
—Scroll of Beginnings

quotes.name: Faerie Invaders
quotes.flavor: Small enough to penetrate the narrowest crack in a castle wall and numerous enough to hack apart a griffin.

quotes.name: Dismiss
quotes.flavor:
"There is nothing you can do that I cannot simply deny."
—Ertai, wizard adept

quotes.name: Elven Chorus
quotes.flavor: Elvish singing was not a thing to miss, in June under the stars.

quotes.name: Gideon's Triumph
quotes.flavor: His triumph came not from victory over his enemies, but from the salvation of those who survived.

quotes.name: Call the Scions
quotes.flavor: Ulamog's progeny swarm the land, draining Zendikar's mana to feed the titan's insatiable hunger.

quotes.name: Etali, Primal Storm
quotes.flavor: The storm rages and the earth breaks.

quotes.name: Borne Upon a Wind
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"I looked on Aragorn and thought how great and terrible a Lord he might have become, had he taken the Ring for himself. Not for naught does Mordor fear him."
—Legolas

quotes.name: Scroll of Fate
quotes.flavor:
"Our stories define our reality."
—Ugin

quotes.name: Etali, Primal Storm
quotes.flavor: The storm rages and the earth breaks.

quotes.name: Wall of Air
quotes.flavor:
"Let the air itself protect you, for it is everywhere."
—Master wizard

quotes.name: Everett K. Ross, Hapless Attaché
quotes.flavor: Everett learned from his experiences escorting Wakandan royalty. This time he brought a bigger car and an extra pair of pants.

quotes.name: Dreampod Druid
quotes.flavor: "Don't mistake my creations for mere vegetation. They are my children, loyal and fierce."

quotes.name: Soulstone Sanctuary
quotes.flavor: By tradition, travelers touched the pillar for good luck. One day, it decided to travel as well.

quotes.name: Seed the Land
quotes.flavor: With a sadness and a sense of hope, Senka left the colony of her birth and, with her attendants, set out to serve as broodmistress, founder of a new colony.

quotes.name: Scrubland
quotes.flavor: 2022 North America Legacy Championship

quotes.name: Worst Fears
quotes.flavor: Elspeth feared that her trespass into Nyx would not go unanswered.

quotes.name: Solitary Cell
quotes.flavor: Denied all tools of necromancy, Liliana endured her least favorite feeling: boredom.

quotes.name: Zerapa Minotaur
quotes.flavor: There's no difference between bone and crystal when it's piercing your throat.

quotes.name: Icatian Town
quotes.flavor: Icatia's once-peaceful towns faced increasing attacks from orcs and goblins as the climate cooled. By the time the empire fell, they were little more than armed camps.

quotes.name: Reverent Mantra
quotes.flavor: She likes the box. Don't make her leave the box.

quotes.name: Scavenging Harpy
quotes.flavor: Desecrating the dead is a convenient way for harpies to expand their foul collections.

quotes.name: Slumbering Trudge
quotes.flavor:
"Yes, she is blocking the path. Are you volunteering to move her?"
—Tam, to Kirol

quotes.name: Soldier On
quotes.flavor: "Everything I've endured, everything I've trained for, has brought me here. You think I'll give up now?"

quotes.name: Prowling Felidar
quotes.flavor: On occasion, felidars leave meaty "gifts" outside the tents of explorers they consider worthy.

quotes.name: Wandermare
quotes.flavor:
"A good steed will carry you home. A great steed will carry you to glory."
—Syr Alin, the Lion's Claw

quotes.name: Gruul Charm
quotes.flavor:
"Not Gruul? Then die!"
—Borborygmos

quotes.name: Crag Puca
quotes.flavor:
"Be happy when you see a puca shaped like mischief. It's far better than one shaped like death."
—Dindun of Kulrath Mine

quotes.name: Precognitive Perception
quotes.flavor: "To control the present we must master the future."

quotes.name: Evolutionary Leap
quotes.flavor: The essence of nature is change.

quotes.name: Moor Fiend
quotes.flavor:
"Let them close the gates of Krov from dusk until dawn if they so choose. It matters not. My fiends shall yet rend their flesh from their bones."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

quotes.name: Mountain
quotes.flavor:
7.
Into the dust of the road, the dusk must burrow. From crag to creekside and past all points beyond, the evening falls.

quotes.name: Hold the Gates
quotes.flavor: "We grew up on these streets. We know them better than any Boros grunt from Zelzo."

quotes.name: Verduran Enchantress
quotes.flavor:
"Graceful? Yes. Beautiful? Absolutely. Harmless? Definitely not."
—Fyndhorn elder

quotes.name: Ravenous Intruder
quotes.flavor:
"I've made some fine acquisitions of late, so I'm planning to make commensurate improvements to my security systems. I have a consultant coming tomorrow."
—Kurna Majan, Luminary League

quotes.name: Mirror Image
quotes.flavor: The life of a shapeshifter is one of constant change.

quotes.name: Jund Panorama
quotes.flavor: The sky is the dragon's throne, the seat from which it issues its fiery decrees.

quotes.name: Curious Pair // Treats to Share
quotes.flavor: "It's gingerbread, like Mother makes. What is there to be afraid of?"

quotes.name: Toxic Scorpion
quotes.flavor:
"You want that venom? Collect it yourself! I'm not losing another pair of dragonhide gloves."
—Old Rutstein

quotes.name: Wild Growth
quotes.flavor:
"Our researchers noted a sense of euphoria and claimed to hear incomprehensible voices. Extreme measures will need to be taken to cull this organism."
—Strangler vine research notes

quotes.name: Amethyst Dragon // Explosive Crystal
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor:
"At least it's a beautiful way to die."
—Erinis, gloom stalker

quotes.name: Olivia's Midnight Ambush
quotes.flavor: "And you were almost finished with that ritual, weren't you, darling? How very rude of me. To make it up to you, I'll send you an invitation to my wedding."

quotes.name: Venerable Monk
quotes.flavor: Age wears the flesh but galvanizes the soul.

quotes.name: Seashell Cameo
quotes.flavor:
"Today a seashell fell from the empty sky here in Kinymu, a hundred leagues from the sea. I'm torn—shall I carve a woman or a bird?"
—Isel, master carver
